description: Read one section of a published GoVisit place profile. Use it when a traveler needs detail on a particular part of the profile, such as location, experiences, accessibility, or nearby places. Returns the selected section and its source page.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

section.description: Published section of the selected page to read.

name: get_place_section

outputSchema.description: Successful read of the sanitized published page snapshot. Unsupported sections reject the invocation.

address.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

addresses.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

chain.description: Name of the brand's chain organization, or null when unknown.

city.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

country.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

email.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

operator.description: Name of the company that manages the physical facility, distinct from profile management, or null when unknown.

owner.description: Name of the property-owning organization, or null when unknown.

phones.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

website.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

websites.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

items.description: Published section records; fields depend on the section and the page projection.

anyOf.description: Named public fields or an items list, such as places.items, location coordinates, opening hours or experience groups.
anyOf.title: Published structured section

data.description: The requested published section. Overview is an object; lists are arrays of at most 20 items; places/experiences may wrap items in an object; missing opening-hours data is null. Strings and nested lists are bounded by the WebMCP snapshot policy.

items.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.

title: Get place section
